facts.fact: The BCEAO licenses electronic money institutions in Senegal; Senegal had three at 31 December 2024 (Wave Digital Finance, Mobile Cash, Orange Finance Mobiles Senegal) per Agence Ecofin.

The BCEAO licensed the fintech Quickpay, a subsidiary of Edkoil group, as an electronic money institution from 3 March 2025, following Wave Digital Finance in April 2022, described as a non-bank, non-telecom licensee.
